subject: English Home Language

show.line: Let's write g for Gogo. Go round, then down and curl like a hook.

rounds.prompt: Tap the letter that says g, as in Gogo.
This letter says g. Say the sound!
Trace g with your finger. Go round, then down and curl.
Find the g with the tail that curls.

hints: g has a tail that hangs down and curls.
Start at the top. Round, down, then curl.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write g for Gogo.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Round, then a short line. Look, I wrote g!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! That is a. g needs a long tail that curls.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Look together. Round, then down and curl. That is g!

parent_line: Can recognise the letter g, say its sound and trace it.
